punchline: Seven-time Western States champion Scott Jurek lost a canyon race to a goat herder in sandals made of old tyre rubber.
thirty_sec: In 2006 Micah True put two men on one line in Mexico's Copper Canyon: Scott Jurek, seven-time Western States champion, and Arnulfo Quimare, a 26-year-old goat herder. Arnulfo ran in huaraches cut from used tyre rubber and had no formal training plan. The course was steep, hot and full of river crossings. Jurek lost to him.
